# Backend Edition (.NET / C# / SQL Server) — policy index

Read this first, then open only the domain files for the code you touch. MUST = mandatory (exception required to deviate); SHOULD = expected (explain deviation in the merge request).

## GOV — Governance and Secure Development Lifecycle → `GOV.md`

- SCS-GOV-01 [MUST] Treat security as a functional requirement
- SCS-GOV-02 [MUST] Assess risk and threat model new applications and major changes
- SCS-GOV-03 [MUST] Review the security architecture before building
- SCS-GOV-04 [MUST] Protect development workstations and confidential designs
- SCS-GOV-05 [MUST] Keep this standard current and acknowledged

## AUTH — Authentication, Credentials and Sessions → `AUTH.md`

- SCS-AUTH-01 [MUST] Use standard identity protocols and the organization's identity provider
- SCS-AUTH-02 [MUST] Apply modern password rules and store passwords with an approved hash
- SCS-AUTH-03 [MUST] Validate tokens fully on every request
- SCS-AUTH-04 [MUST] Limit failed login attempts and log them
- SCS-AUTH-05 [MUST] Require MFA for administrative, privileged and remote access
- SCS-AUTH-06 [MUST] Never ship or keep default credentials or test accounts
- SCS-AUTH-07 [MUST] Manage sessions and tokens securely

## AUTHZ — Authorization and Access Control → `AUTHZ.md`

- SCS-AUTHZ-01 [MUST] Enforce role-based access control on the server for every feature
- SCS-AUTHZ-02 [MUST] Check ownership of every object a request touches
- SCS-AUTHZ-03 [MUST] Review application access rights and revoke them promptly

## INP — Input Validation, Output Encoding and Injection → `INP.md`

- SCS-INP-01 [MUST] Validate all input on the server; client validation is for usability only
- SCS-INP-02 [MUST] Parameterize every database query
- SCS-INP-03 [MUST] Encode output for its context to prevent XSS
- SCS-INP-04 [MUST] Build URLs, paths and commands with safe APIs
- SCS-INP-05 [MUST] Deserialize only into fixed, expected types

## API — API and Integration Security → `API.md`

- SCS-API-01 [MUST] Authenticate and authorize every API request by default
- SCS-API-02 [MUST] Use request and response DTOs; never bind or return entities
- SCS-API-03 [MUST] Rate-limit and bound the resources every endpoint can consume
- SCS-API-04 [MUST] Restrict CORS to an explicit allow-list of origins
- SCS-API-05 [MUST] Version APIs and keep an inventory of all endpoints
- SCS-API-06 [MUST] Use least-privilege service accounts for SAP RFC/BAPI integration
- SCS-API-07 [MUST] Treat responses from third-party and internal services as untrusted
- SCS-API-08 [MUST] Prevent server-side request forgery (SSRF)

## CRY — Cryptography and Data in Transit → `CRY.md`

- SCS-CRY-01 [MUST] Encrypt all data in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher
- SCS-CRY-02 [MUST] Use only approved algorithms and platform crypto libraries
- SCS-CRY-03 [MUST] Manage encryption keys securely

## DATA — Data Protection and Privacy → `DATA.md`

- SCS-DATA-01 [MUST] Classify data and handle it according to its classification
- SCS-DATA-02 [MUST] Collect and keep only the personal data you need
- SCS-DATA-03 [MUST] Support personal data breach notification

## SEC — Secrets and Configuration → `SEC.md`

- SCS-SEC-01 [MUST] Never hardcode or commit secrets
- SCS-SEC-02 [MUST] Load secrets from secure configuration and validate them at startup
- SCS-SEC-03 [SHOULD] Scan for secrets before every commit and in CI

## ERR — Error Handling and Exceptional Conditions → `ERR.md`

- SCS-ERR-01 [MUST] Show generic errors to users; keep details in server logs
- SCS-ERR-02 [MUST] Fail closed and leave no half-finished work

## LOG — Logging, Monitoring and Alerting → `LOG.md`

- SCS-LOG-01 [MUST] Log security events in a structured format
- SCS-LOG-02 [MUST] Never log secrets or personal data, and neutralize log injection
- SCS-LOG-03 [MUST] Monitor applications and alert on security events

## FILE — File Upload and File Handling → `FILE.md`

- SCS-FILE-01 [MUST] Validate uploaded files by size, type and content
- SCS-FILE-02 [MUST] Store and serve files safely

## DB — SQL Server Database Security → `DB.md`

- SCS-DB-01 [MUST] Parameterize stored procedures and dynamic SQL
- SCS-DB-02 [MUST] Give applications least-privilege database logins
- SCS-DB-03 [MUST] Encrypt sensitive data and connections in SQL Server
- SCS-DB-04 [MUST] Keep SQL Server auditing on in production
- SCS-DB-05 [MUST] Encrypt and protect database backups

## WEB — ASP.NET Core Web Hardening → `WEB.md`

- SCS-WEB-01 [MUST] Enforce HTTPS and HSTS in production
- SCS-WEB-02 [MUST] Send security headers on every response
- SCS-WEB-03 [MUST] Protect cookie-authenticated requests against CSRF
- SCS-WEB-04 [SHOULD] Configure hosts, proxies and caching safely

## SUP — Supply Chain and Third-Party Components → `SUP.md`

- SCS-SUP-01 [MUST] Vet third-party packages before adopting them
- SCS-SUP-02 [MUST] Scan dependencies continuously and keep them patched
- SCS-SUP-03 [MUST] Lock dependencies and verify build artifacts
- SCS-SUP-04 [MUST] Assess vendor and acquired applications before adoption

## DEP — Source Control, Environments, Change and Deployment → `DEP.md`

- SCS-DEP-01 [MUST] Protect source code with Git branch protection
- SCS-DEP-02 [MUST] Follow formal change management, including for emergencies
- SCS-DEP-03 [MUST] Validate security configuration before every production release

## TEST — Security Testing and Code Review → `TEST.md`

- SCS-TEST-01 [MUST] Include security scenarios in functional, integration and UAT testing
- SCS-TEST-02 [SHOULD] Run standard code evaluation tools on your own code before submitting
- SCS-TEST-03 [MUST] Security Reviewer evaluates security and reports every weakness found
- SCS-TEST-04 [MUST] Get final security approval from the Security Reviewer before production

## OPS — Operations, Vulnerability Management and Incident Response → `OPS.md`

- SCS-OPS-01 [MUST] Fix vulnerabilities within defined timeframes
- SCS-OPS-02 [SHOULD] Learn from security incidents with blameless reviews
- SCS-OPS-03 [SHOULD] Design for failure and resilience
- SCS-OPS-04 [MUST] Decommission applications securely
